messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Each semaglutide brand or formulation is FDA-approved for specific conditions and patient populations.
Triplet: ["Semaglutide", "has fda approval for", "specific conditions"]

The relation 'has fda approval for' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is approved by the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) for the condition or patient population specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'used in population': The subject drug is used in or approved for the patient population or age group specified by the object entity.
B. 'fda approved': The subject entity has been approved by the FDA, as indicated by the object entity.
C. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'fda approval year': The subject drug was approved by the US FDA in the year specified by the object entity.
E. 'applies to patients who are to be managed with': The subject drug is used for patients who are managed with the procedure or treatment specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
